Tooltip_OA_FieldTerminal: The research team's field terminal. It comes by helicopter; put it down where you like. It opens research team goods, special requests and flight support. The assembled terminal still works.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_shredBench: A hand bench that shreds things into sample bundles. No electricity needed. Five game minutes for each unit of weight.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_bulkShredder: Shreds whole boxes of goods into sample bundles, 12 weight an hour. Needs electricity. Loud.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_cutter: Cuts clothes into rags, denim and leather, 36 weight an hour. Needs electricity.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_propaneRefiner: Turns rotten food into propane and fills an empty tank. Needs electricity.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_oilRefiner: Refines cooking oil, lard and seeds into petrol and fills an empty can. Needs electricity.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_woodSaw: Saws logs (weight 9) into 6 planks each, 180 weight an hour. Gives no carpentry experience. Needs electricity. Very loud.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_researchStorage: A large storage locker for the base.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_researchCrate: A storage crate you can stack three high.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_rainStorage: A large open-top water storage. Holds 4000 L and collects about 72 L an hour in heavy rain. Place it outdoors with no roof above.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_lure: Sounds every 15 minutes for a day, drawing zombies from far away. Once spent it stays, switched off. Taken back while it works, it keeps the time it has left.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_motor: A machine motor. Better tiers work on more things at once (1, 2, 3), a little faster, and draw more electricity. Wears while the machine runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_shredBlade: A blade for the bulk shredder. Better tiers get more sample bundles from the same load. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_cutBlade: A blade for the fabric cutter. Better tiers cut more pieces. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_sawBlade: A blade for the log saw. Better tiers give more planks. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_catalyst: A catalyst filter for the refineries. Better tiers use less material. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_cover: A soundproof cover for any powered machine. Halves the noise radius but works a little slower. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_CureLeft: %1 days of shelf life left. Only the person it was issued to can use it.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_CureExpired: Past its shelf life. It does nothing.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_CureNotOwner: Issued to someone else. It does nothing for you.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_DelayInfo: Holds the infection's progress for %1 days. A new wound from a zombie ends it.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Reinforced: A reinforced door. Needs rank 2 of this enhancement.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_NeedPryBar: Needs a crowbar or pry bar.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_NeedPickTools: Needs a paperclip and a screwdriver.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_PryInfo: %1 success. Fast but loud. A failure costs endurance and adds fatigue.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_PickInfo: %1 success. Slow but quiet. A failure ruins the paperclip.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_DisarmInfo: %1 success. A failure ruins the paperclip.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumScout: Gives one point for Field Detection Enhancement. The first one opens the line.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumLoad: Gives one point for Load Adaptation Enhancement. The first one opens the line.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumSurviva: Gives one point for Survival Adaptation Enhancement. The first one opens the line.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumShared: Gives one point usable in any line.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_DelayDrug: Holds the infection's progress for 1 day. A new wound from a zombie ends it. It never expires.
Tooltip_OA_Story_AnalysisReply: An analysis reply sent by the team.
Tooltip_OA_Story_CellLog: A cell block roll-call record. The pencil writing is faint.
Tooltip_OA_Story_ClinicRecord: Only the pages of the first week of July are smeared in the copy. The last line is cut off at the page edge.
Tooltip_OA_Story_CopyOriginal: The original of a copy. Its number has to be checked against the copy.
Tooltip_OA_Story_DeadDropCase: A small case someone left behind.
Tooltip_OA_Story_EvidenceEnvelope: A police intake slip is attached. The seal was torn once and stuck back.
Tooltip_OA_Story_FarmJournal: Weather and livestock notes in pencil. From late June the same words come back on a few pages.
Tooltip_OA_Story_FieldCallDevice: A call device for use inside a mission area. Runs on its own battery.
Tooltip_OA_Story_FilterBundle: Several filters tied together. Thick with dust.
Tooltip_OA_Story_HandoverFile: Handover papers for the change of department.
Tooltip_OA_Story_KitVoucher: A voucher good for one use.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MeteorFragment: A fragment picked up where a meteorite came down. Sent to the research team in a delivery box, it opens the last enhancement of the survival adaptation line.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MeteorFragmentIron: A fragment picked up where a meteorite came down. Sent to the research team in a delivery box, it opens the last enhancement of the load adaptation line.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MeteorFragmentStonyIron: A fragment picked up where a meteorite came down. Sent to the research team in a delivery box, it opens the last enhancement of the field detection line.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MissionEnvelope: A sealed document envelope. Nothing is written on the outside.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MissionFabricRoll: A bundle of cloth scraps rolled up.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MissionFilterCase: A case holding filters that were taken out.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MissionLogbook: A handwritten logbook. The page corners are folded.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MissionSampleTin: A small tin with a numbered tag on the lid.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MissionTape: A tape with a half-torn label.
Tooltip_OA_Story_ReviewMemo: A copy with its number erased. Deeply creased.
Tooltip_OA_Story_RosterLostPage: A single loose page missing from a roster.
Tooltip_OA_Story_RosterPage: A page torn out of the gym roster. Each name has a four-digit number in the next column.
Tooltip_OA_Story_SampleCase: A sealed sample case sent by the team. Do not open.
Tooltip_OA_Story_SampleCooler: Heavy. The unit on the label is scraped off; only a form number and a receipt date remain.
Tooltip_OA_Story_SerumSheet: Instructions that come with an assigned serum.
Tooltip_OA_Story_SoilFar: Samples can only be taken close to the drop site.
Tooltip_OA_Story_SoilSample: Soil in a small tub with a numbered tag.
Tooltip_OA_Story_StakeTag: A tag that hangs on a survey stake. A number is written on it.
Tooltip_OA_Story_WardRecord: A ward nursing log. Some pages are stuck together.
Tooltip_OA_Story_WeatherLog: A page from early July is torn out. The pages before and after both say 'visibility poor'.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_TeamBackpack: Team issue pack. The two canteens built into its sides are its water storage and hold 1.8 L.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_TeamWaistBag: Team issue fanny pack. Wear it in front or behind.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_TeamFuelCan: Team gas can. Holds 12 L; an expansion kit makes it hold more, a lightening kit makes it lighter.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_TeamWelder: A welding torch the team has worked over. Expansion kits make it last longer, lightening kits make it lighter.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_FieldTool: Team issue tool, lighter and longer lasting than the plain one. Lightening and reinforcement kits improve it further.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_KitCapacity: Fit it to a bag, the team gas can or the team welding torch: a bag holds 10%% more of its original capacity, the can 2 L more, the torch 20%% more of a plain torch's uses. A vehicle's storage takes it from the mechanics window.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_KitLightening: Fit it to a bag, the team gas can, the team welding torch or a field tool. A bag takes more weight off what it holds, up to 95%%; the rest weigh less, 12%% with the first kit and a little less with each after.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_KitReinforcement: Fit it to a field tool: it lasts 25%% longer of its original condition. A tool takes up to four.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_KitEngine: Adds 10%% to an engine's original power and 5%% to its noise. A louder engine draws more zombies. Fit it from the vehicle's mechanics window.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_BagCut: Without PZ Extension API this bag holds only up to %1.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_LightKits: Lightening kits fitted: %1 (%2 of its weight)
Tooltip_OA_Gear_StorageCut: Without PZ Extension API a vehicle's storage holds only up to %1.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_NoTarget_capacity: You have no bag, team gas can or team welding torch to fit it to.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_NoTarget_lightening: You have no bag, team gas can, team welding torch or field tool to fit it to.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_NoTarget_reinforcement: You have no field tool to fit it to.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_FitVehicle: Fit it from the vehicle's mechanics window: right-click a storage or the engine.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_NoVehicleKit: You have no %1 for this vehicle.
Tooltip_OA_Gear_RedeemInfo: Trade it for one kit of your choice.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_DelayDrugLong: Holds the infection's progress for 7 days. A new wound from a zombie ends it. It never expires.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_InfectionReversal: Sets the infection's progress back to nothing, so the nausea and the health limit ease. The infection stays: a delay drug is still needed.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_InfectionTestKit: Shows at once whether you are infected. Until a wound from a zombie is tested for, deliveries carry the infection handling fee.
Tooltip_OA_Story_HandoverPages: Papers to be passed to the new department. A list is attached on top.
Tooltip_OA_Story_MissionHeavyCase: A thick hard case with carry handles. Too heavy to carry far on your own.
